title: Competency-based staff and organisational development
summary: Conceptual considerations on how existing competencies, tasks and organisational requirements can be systematically aligned with one another.

text: Why does a company sometimes need not more staff, but a better allocation of its existing resources?
Conceptual considerations on how existing competencies, tasks and organisational requirements can be systematically aligned with one another.
The focus is on identifying existing potential, assigning tasks transparently and developing possible approaches to the effective use of resources.

stages.title: Expected impact
items: possible reduction of avoidable staff shortages

text: Independent conceptual considerations and development of an allocation model. No specific staffing decisions, employee data or internal HR procedures are presented.
In future, the conceptual basis can be developed into a data-based model.
